title: LinkedIn activity feed (recent posts)
journal: linkedin.com/in/israelxdiaz/recent-activity, captured via Mike's logged-in session, 5 of 12 items rendered
abstract: Original post (~Aug 2026, edited) launching Magnum Opus at magnumopus.conxios.com: a paid, AI-guided single-conversation self-knowledge product mapping a person across '14 different dimensions of a life,' pitched as a synthesis of '174+ frameworks in psychology, behavioural science, developmental theory, and ancient wisdom' pulled apart and tested with executive teams, individuals, and teenagers over roughly a decade. Explicitly positioned as a real document, not a quiz or chatbot-therapist impression, priced below a corporate retreat. Remaining four feed items are shares of the four LinkedIn articles already captured as separate records, with original captions — notably a caption claiming consciOS achieved 'the highest benchmark score recorded by AI for Human Flourishing + Harvard University' (same claim as the Aug 25 2025 article; see FACTCHECK for verification status).
